# LPL Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results


LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) (the "Company") today announced results for its second quarter ended June 30, 2026, reporting net income of $379 million, or $4.74 per share.


Last Edited by: LPL Financial


Last Updated: July 29, 2026
